{{Quote|Let me go, you ''fools!"<br />"''The ''only'' place you'll be going is to an intergalactic trial&hellip; ''Governor'' Kugg!|Kugg and Althon|<ref name="Droids 1">[[Droids (1986) 1|''Droids'' (1986) 1]]</ref>}}
An '''intergalactic trial''' was a way of prosecuting criminals.<ref name="Droids 1" /> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DroidsComicDate}}</ref> after the people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]] were able to overthrow their tyrannical [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Kugg]], [[Head Councilman]] [[Althon]] told Kugg that the only place he would be going would be an [[Galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] trial.<ref name="Droids 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The intergalactic trial was introduced in the [[Droids (1986) 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]] and published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[1986]].<ref name="Droids 1" />
